parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.9865). The gain from DEPTH=10 was lost, likely due to fewer training steps per 5-minute budget at higher capacity. Reverting to DEPTH=10. Next: testing MATRIX_LR=0.06 (lower LR) with DEPTH=10 to improve convergence stability, following the team's successful trend of combining capacity with lower learning rates.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=10 and reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.06 to stabilize convergence and recover gains lost to step count reduction in the DEPTH=12 run.
